related.description: Spotify & Apple Music in your macOS menu bar
A simple Spotify lyrics viewer menu bar app for macOS in Swift 3
macOS app that allows the control of Spotify and AppleMusic/iTunes music playback from the menu bar.
📃 Get lyrics of currently playing Spotify song so you don't sing along with the wrong ones and embarrass yourself later. Very fast.
LyricGlow for macOS, an always-on-top Electron widget showing real-time, word-by-word synced lyrics with glow effects, plus artist metadata...
